description.content: Estimated income tax for the current SA tax year, calculated from the freelancer's PAID transactions.

exec: pm.test("estimatedTax is a non-negative number", function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.estimatedTax).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(d.estimatedTax).to.be.at.least(0); });
